summary: Pinball entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Pinball
entries.definitive_edition: NES Nintendo Classics release for the home version; Arcade Archives for the arcade build

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics NES app; Arcade Archives for VS. Pinball
emulation.notes: Use Nintendo Classics for the main NES route and Arcade Archives only to compare arcade version behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official modern emulation of NES and arcade builds on Switch.

primary.version: NES Pinball in the NES Nintendo Classics app
primary.why: No Sami platform was specified, so the current official Nintendo Classics route is the cleanest main playthrough of Nintendo's NES/Famicom Pinball. The arcade VS. System build is preserved separately through Arcade Archives as a secondary comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pinball in the NES Nintendo Classics app with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Use Arcade Archives: VS. Pinball only if you want to compare the arcade build.

secondary.exclusive_content: Arcade Archives: VS. Pinball preserves the Nintendo VS. System arcade version rather than the NES/Famicom home version.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Arcade Archives release for arcade behavior and presentation after the NES Nintendo Classics route.
secondary.why: A distinct arcade version was released through Arcade Archives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Virtual Console routes are legacy storefront releases. Nintendo Switch Online requires a subscription; Arcade Archives is a separate arcade-version purchase.
